title: Grill me
summary: Interviews you relentlessly to sharpen a plan or design.
details: Invoking grill-me starts a relentless interview that sharpens a plan or design, by handing the work to the grilling skill. It is for anyone who wants their thinking stress-tested before committing to it. It adds a skill folder that only you can start, since Claude cannot invoke it on its own, and that loads only when used; it is instructions only, so no code runs.
trigger: Type /grill-me with the plan or idea to stress-test.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
